worldcombat.skill.focusenergy.summary: Take a deep breath and gather the mind to a point: the breath deepens with time, and every hit in the window has a better chance to crit. Hitting does not spend it; the breath only fades when the window ends. It cannot be used while Dragon Cheer is on the user.
worldcombat.skill.focusenergy.use.0: Open a fight with a breath so every later hit finds the weak point
worldcombat.skill.focusenergy.use.1: Sharpen the aim before the foe eats a combo
worldcombat.skill.focusenergy.use.2: Make the foe afraid to close in before the breath runs out
worldcombat.skill.focusenergy.descriptio: At full breath each damaging hit gains about %1$s crit chance; the breath stays for %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.focusenergy.deep.on: Deep breath: +15% bonus chance and full focus arrives sooner, at the cost of %1$s telegraph and %2$s cooldown - sit down before a hard fight.
worldcombat.skill.focusenergy.deep.off: Shallow breath: a little less bonus and slower focus, but lower telegraph and cooldown - keep topping it up in a long trade.
worldcombat.skill.focusenergy.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.focusenergy.preference: On: deep breath, +15% bonus chance and faster full focus, but 3 ticks more telegraph and a longer cooldown - sit down before a hard fight. Off: shallow breath, less bonus and slower focus, but a shorter telegraph and cooldown, ready to top up in a long trade.
Consider the breath when a threat is within this distance; larger starts the breath earlier.
A threat closer than this makes the companion fight instead of breathing; larger gives up the breath more often up close.
